name: Fortignathus
sum: Fortignathus is a crocodylomorph known from a few partial specimens from the Cretaceous Echkar Formation of Niger.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: One of three incompletely preserved specimens from Niger.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Young et al. 2016
